RILEGGI LIVE – Manchester City-Napoli, Allegri: “De Bruyne? Valutazioni dopo il 20 dicembre. Non dobbiamo ripetere gli errori di Porto”

📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (616 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Iamnaples

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Non ci ho parlato, siamo in piena fase di stagione tra campionato e Champions, e tra poco ci sarà la Coppa Italia.
  • It has been revealed that allegri: “Queste grandi partite si preparano da soli con le motivazioni.
  • Industry observers note that allegri: “Abbiamo la panchina corta.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Allegri: “De Bruyne? Non ci ho parlato, siamo in piena fase di stagione tra campionato e Champions, e tra poco ci sarà la Coppa Italia. Quando ci sarà la sosta di Natale, la società farà le sue valutazioni per sistemare la rosa della squadra, poi dipenderà anche dalla volontà di alcuni giocatori. Ma ora bisogna tenere alta la concentrazione fino al 20 dicembre dopo la partita con l’Atalanta. Questa partita conta tanto, a Porto per 60-70 minuti abbiamo fatto bene, poi abbiamo concesso dei gol un pochino troppo facili, poi sarà ancora più complicata domani, il livello è più alto. Dobbiamo avere l’obiettivo del risultato attraverso una prestazione fatta con e senza palla. Dopo la partita ripenseremo alla Champions per il Brugge che sarà da dentro o fuori, ma nel mezzo ci sarà da sistemare il campionato. Ora viviamoci questa partita”.

It has been revealed that allegri: “Queste grandi partite si preparano da soli con le motivazioni. Detto questo, ci sono difficoltà oggettive della partita contro squadre con fisicità e qualità. Queste partite vanno giocate bene tecnicamente quando si attacca, quando non ce l’abbiamo dobbiamo difendere di squadra e restare sempre dentro la partita, cosa che non è accaduta contro il Porto. La Premier mi ha sempre affascinato, ma non ho rimpianti per le scelte che ho fatto nella mia carriera, sono stato fortunato, ho allenato club importanti come Juve, Milan, Napoli e anche il Cagliari. Mi ritengo molto fortunato. Venire in questi stadi è sempre bello, ti confronti con squadre di alto livello, facciamo questo lavoro anche per dimostrare di essere bravi e di essere i migliori. Io credo che l’obiettivo chiaro è quello di passare il turno. Se facessimo risultato domani sarebbe meraviglioso. Ma anche la sconfitta non pregiudicherebbe niente, ci sarebbe sempre la possibilità di superare il turno”.

Industry observers note that allegri: “Abbiamo la panchina corta. Di Lorenzo e Badiashile saranno disponibili per Lecce. Favasuli e Marianucci non sono in lista, abbiamo perso anche Meret e Vergara, ma fa parte del gioco. Ho visto i numeri e ci sono tante squadre con tanti infortunati. Faremo di necessità virtù, poi dovremo sistemare il campionato, dove potevamo avere qualche punto in più. Lang e Anguissa? Dopo la partita di sabato abbiamo recuperato. Ci vorrà una gran partita e una dose di fortuna”.

According to recent reports, allegri: “Commento alle parole di Maresca? Ho detto che non è decisiva, perché aritmeticamente anche in caso di vittoria domani 6 punti non basterebbero per qualificarsi. Fino all’ultima giornata proveremo a conquistare la qualificazione. È una questione matematica. Quindi bisogna fare qualche risultato positivo, ci servono tre vittorie. Sappiamo delle difficoltà, giochiamo contro una delle migliori in Europa che ha cambiato tanti giocatori ma che ha qualità importanti. È sempre tra le favorite alla vittoria finale della Champions, dovremo cercare di creare le condizioni migliori possibili per attaccarli”.

Massimiliano Allegri, allenatore del Napoli, parlerà in conferenza stampa alla vigilia del match contro il Manchester City.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Scegli Fcinter1908.it come tuo sito preferito su Google: clicca qui.

It has been revealed that tra le pagine dell'edizione odierna del Corriere dello Sport, Alberto Polverosi, giornalista, ha analizzato così il pareggio per 4-4 tra Atalanta e Inter: "Avevano vinto tutte le grandi, quelle della zona-Champions, della zona-Coppe bis e perfino le più deludenti come Napoli e Juventus, peraltro segnando una valanga di gol, e tutti gli allenatori felici e contenti. L’Inter invece è saltata via dalla lista dei tre punti e alla fine in questa galleria di facce sorridenti è mancata proprio quella di Chivu, segnata dallo stress di una partita follemente bella soprattutto per l’Atalanta, che l’ha ripresa su rigore in pieno recupero. Quattro a quattro, l’Inter sempre in vantaggio di due gol e alla fine agguantata da una squadra che non ha pensato nemmeno per un istante di averla persa. Così le romane hanno allungato mentre Milan e Como si sono avvicinate, ma più dei riflessi sulla classifica a Chivu deve interessare un altro tipo di riflessi, quelli tardivi della sua difesa. Che ha preso 17 gol in 12 partite, un numero troppo pesante per chi punta allo scudetto.

L’Inter aveva l’ostacolo più complicato in questa giornata se vista dalla parte delle grandi e se non è riuscita a superarlo, come si poteva immaginare dopo la prima mezz’ora, è stato per merito dell’Atalanta quanto per demerito suo. Era entrata col piede giusto in questa partita, come era accaduto prima della sosta col Como, tanto per far capire che il tempo del risveglio dopo le labbrate era alle spalle. Aggressiva nella metà campo della Dea, ha giocato, costruito occasioni e segnato due gol in trenta minuti. Poi sono sopraggiunti i difetti. Il primo: troppo bellini in area bergamasca, un tocco, due, un passaggino, un colpetto, è mancata la stoccata. Il secondo: sul 2-0, prima flessione mentale, gol di Elmas e partita riaperta. Sul 3-1, seconda flessione e rete di De Ketelaere.

Sul 4-2 terza e doppia flessione con la doppietta del belga e il gol su rigore di Kessie. Completata così una serata che non andrà giù all’allenatore. Nel tentativo di riacciuffare il risultato la partita dell’Atalanta era inevitabilmente cambiata, lasciava spazi di cui Thuram si era impossessato con un paio di contropiedi fenomenali e soprattutto decisivi. Ma nemmeno in quei momenti l’Inter è stata davvero padrona. Sembrava esplodere di salute con un centravanti che sta vivendo il suo momento di grazia. Pio Esposito era passato da Chivu a Mancini e da Mancini a Chivu senza alterare il suo prodotto, i gol. Con la tripletta di ieri, fra Inter e Nazionale è arrivato a otto reti in cinque partite. Tocca una palla e la butta dentro. Intorno a lui stava giocando l’Inter dei momenti in cui niente le è vietato.

Fisicamente straripante, tecnicamente di livello superiore (non solo rispetto all’Atalanta) e poi convinta di quanto sta facendo. Mezz’ora. E poi? E poi su e giù, bene davanti, malissimo dietro, senza equilibrio, senza sentirsi certa della sua forza, oscillava da una parte all’altra del campo, in totale confusione quando doveva difendere. I cambi di Chivu non l’hanno aiutata, mentre quelli di Sarri hanno dato all’Atalanta la spinta decisiva per un’impresa. I complimenti, col punto, vanno all’Atalanta che ha messo la partita (dal 30' del primo tempo fino al recupero del secondo) sullo stesso terreno dei nerazzurri, ritmo, velocità, intensità, aggressività, il secondo tempo della Dea è stato da applausi, quello dell’Inter da incubo".

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

La vendita per i tifosi ospiti resta sospesa in attesa della determina dell’Osservatorio sulle Manifestazioni Sportive.

I biglietti per Lazio-Atalanta saranno in vendita dalle 11 di martedì 24 novembre. Secondo quanto riportato da Sslazio, La partita di Serie A Enilive si giocherà domenica 6 dicembre alle 15, come comunica la S.S. Lazio.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Le tariffe agevolate per invalidi al 100% e persone disabili in carrozzella, entrambe con accompagnatore, sono acquistabili soltanto nei negozi Lazio Style 1900, escluso quello di Parco Leonardo. La stessa modalità è prevista per i biglietti ridotti riservati agli invalidi civili al 100% e per la Tribuna Tevere non deambulanti, in entrambi i casi con accompagnatore.

Sources indicate that chi possiede una Fidelity Card Millenovecento o Eagle e non è abbonato può chiedere, anche durante l’acquisto online, che il titolo d’ingresso sia caricato elettronicamente sulla tessera. Ai biglietti acquistati online si applica una commissione di servizio del 3,80%.

It has been revealed that il biglietto Ridotto Under 16 è disponibile per i ragazzi nati dal 1° gennaio 2010. I ragazzi nati dal 1° gennaio 2012 possono invece accedere gratuitamente allo stadio se accompagnati da un genitore, o da un parente entro il quarto grado, in possesso di un biglietto a pagamento.

In a recent development, per l’Omaggio Under 14, il tagliando nominativo gratuito va ritirato contemporaneamente all’acquisto del biglietto dell’adulto. L’operazione si effettua esclusivamente nei Lazio Style 1900, tranne Parco Leonardo, oppure, soltanto il giorno della gara, alla biglietteria di Via Nigra. La Lazio mette a disposizione le indicazioni per gli omaggi Under 14.

I bambini di quattro anni nati dal 1° gennaio 2022 entrano gratuitamente e senza biglietto, presentando un documento d’identità o la tessera sanitaria.

Tech Report: Man City survive tunnel clash and Porto fury thanks to Haaland double

⏱️ ~26 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Erling Haaland revealed on the eve of this clash how he loves chopping firewood in his spare time – and his goals set alight Manchester City’s Champions League campaign on a fractious evening in Porto.
  • So much for the fresh group stage of the competition taking time to warm up.
  • Recent findings suggest that and City were not easing themselves back into European action either, they went full throttle at the start of a tough set of group games.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Erling Haaland revealed on the eve of this clash how he loves chopping firewood in his spare time – and his goals set alight Manchester City’s Champions League campaign on a fractious evening in Porto.

So much for the fresh group stage of the competition taking time to warm up. This clash was a hot-blooded, bitter contest that spilt over in the tunnel at half-time, with players getting separated and tempers rising.

Recent findings suggest that and City were not easing themselves back into European action either, they went full throttle at the start of a tough set of group games. With Enzo Maresca, it looks like it will be all-out attack to get the best out of this team.

Sources indicate that they can look nervous at the back, particularly with the ball at Gianluigi Donnarumma’s feet, but have attacking weapons to hurt any team in this elite competition. This was a performance that their rivals will take note of.

“It was a complete performance on and off the ball for 95 minutes,” was Maresca’s assessment.

It has been revealed that city will certainly scare the traditional heavyweights with Haaland leading their attack and taking an axe to Porto’s defence like he does with logs in his back garden. It was his 58th and 59th goal in 59 games in the Champions League, with his latest an expertly directed header off a post and a calm side-footed finish.

NO MISTAKE from Erling Haaland this time 💪He's put Man City 1-0 up in Porto 🇵🇹 pic.twitter.com/UpKOqQA49s.

There is an argument that Pep Guardiola could have achieved more in the Champions League, given City’s dominance in domestic football. They have been knocked out by Real Madrid in the last three seasons but this is a new City, different personnel and even a new look.

They wore their black and yellow away kit, inspired by “Manchester’s iconic worker bee” according to Puma, and grafted their way to victory here. Non-stop running going forward, and scrapping with Porto, too.

Sources indicate that the Portuguese champions were not happy with Marc Guéhi’s challenge on Gabri Veiga and claimed an elbow was used, with the row carrying on in the tunnel at half-time with security guards separating the players. Rúben Dias also appeared to nudge a Porto official on his way to the dressing room.

Industry observers note that “I didn’t see anything but anyway, you can ask how many times you see me or my bench stand up? Zero, for 95 minutes. How many times do you see their bench? So...” Maresca added.

Only Dias and Haaland remain from the starting line-up from the Champions League triumph three years ago, so this is essentially a upcoming team with a new manager.

Erling Haaland seals the deal in Porto 🤝🇵🇹 pic.twitter.com/10xSTtZ8nw.

Phil Foden, on as a sub in that game, started at Estádio do Dragão after his horse Wreck It Ronnie defeated Najidi Storm, which started the Goodwood race with 1-33 odds and is now the shortest-priced loser in British racing history. The rest of the team are latest to City’s challenge.

That includes Ayyoub Bouaddi, 18, who was part of a £320m midfield refresh following the departure of Rodri, who was named among the Ballon d’Or nominees a few hours before kick-off to highlight the experience and class City have lost.

Recent findings suggest that bouaddi, who cost £81.4m from Lille, made a good start in his full debut. The Moroccan teenager is neat on the ball and gets around the pitch, with the next step being able to dominate games like his predecessor.

“In his last game he lost two balls and stayed calm and was back in our box,” Maresca noted. “This indicates how good he is because any player after two [poor] passes panics, but he is just 18. Erling, Rúben, Mateo [Kovacic], they can manage these kind of games better, but you don’t expect it from a guy of 18. I didn’t see him panic.”.

Sources indicate that by Bouaddi’s side in midfield was Enzo Fernández, who sought to drive forward into space when City counter-attacked. He was among the players who, along with Dias, were reminded of their Benfica history by the home fans.

Recent findings suggest that diogo Costa tends to be linked with a move to the Premier League every summer, but has been a one-club man for his career so far. But he revealed why clubs are looking at him with his first-half saves to deny Haaland and Rayan Cherki.

Porto’s legendary goalkeeper, Helton, was in the press box at half-time and would have been impressed with the saves, although he was not in his seat when Haaland scored the first goal, which came 94 seconds after the restart.

Industry observers note that city had worked the ball around the penalty area, with Antoine Semenyo drawing out Costa before laying off to Fernández. Haaland’s header from the cross had such precision that the goalkeeper did not dive as it angled in off a post.

Still, Porto had their chances with Alberto Costa heading wide from a corner and William Gomes charging down a Donnarumma kick – with City’s most nervous moments coming when they passed around their back line.

Man City are living dangerously here! 🫣Donnarumma nearly gifts Porto an equaliser 😬 pic.twitter.com/otIfZTHmdn.

But Haaland sealed the win as the game ticked into stoppage time, finding the bottom corner from Rayan Aït-Nouri’s cutback.

Sources indicate that “It was an amazing game against the champions of Portugal. We knew it would be a difficult fight, man against man, they are a top team,” Haaland said. “They play amazing football. All the pressure, we have to deliver on the major stage and that’s what we did. We controlled the whole first half, created chances.”.

In a recent development, for Maresca, the victory was also a challenge against Porto’s aggression, with the Italian coach adding: “I was very pleased. We know in this kind of game when you come here it’s always difficult or tricky. The environment, the way they grew up, it’s normal, but I think we dealt with that very good.”.

Top performance, Enzo 👊✨ pic.twitter.com/ds0f207tpS.

Man City have now won seven of their last eight opening matchdays in the UEFA Champions League 🔵Starting strong 💪 pic.twitter.com/CIjsMj4Dig.

“I think we could have scored more goals, especially in the first half. We overall deserved the win and happy with the performance. If you think you can come to a place like this and play and not concede any chances, that is not realistic and it is normal. I am quite lucky as I have a squad of good players. It is a special competition and all the games are very difficult. He [Ayyoub Bouaddi] never panicked and was very good. The performance from him was unbelievable. I am happy to reunite with Enzo [Fernandez], who was very good.”.

36 - Erling Haaland scored his 36th UEFA Champions League goal for Manchester City, equalling Sergio Agüero as joint-most for the Citizens in the competition.Inevitability. pic.twitter.com/HHbNadybxh.

According to recent reports, “I am so happy with how my teammates have welcomed me into the club. They are not just great players but great human beings. The fans have been absolutely brilliant and this is a latest step in my career. Erling [Haaland] is an animal, a beast. Every time I am on the pitch, I will look for him and look to assist him. He is an amazing human being and helped me settle in. I am happy Enzo [Maresca] did all he good to make the move happen. I am so grateful for everything he has done for me and my family.”.

5️⃣9️⃣ appearances 5️⃣9️⃣ goals@Erling's #UCL record 🤯 pic.twitter.com/v6IvpwC9vm.

“Amazing game against the champions of Portugal. We knew it was going to be a tough game, they play amazing football. We had to deliver on the biggest stage and we did. We controlled the whole of the first half. We created a lot of chances. They pushed us for a good 25 minutes in the second half but we pulled through. These are the games we have to win. We have had a great start to the season.

Industry observers note that “He [Ayyoub Bouaddi] had a really good game and he has been amazing in training. I think we have a gem there. We have to learn and Enzo [Maresca] demands a lot from us. We demand a lot from each other. It was an unreal atmosphere so I hope Enzo is happy with that.”.

The final whistle is blown and Manchester City begin their Champions League campaign with a 2-0 win in Porto. Erling Haaland’s double gives Enzo Maresca a victory in his first Champions League game in charge of Manchester City.

According to recent reports, enzo has two shots from range in quick succession, one from a free-kick. The free-kick goes just wide and the second is saved by D Costa.

It has been an ill-tempered game and tempers have boiled over again. Rosario and Haaland are involved in a tussle on the floor, which then leads to a mass melee. Haaland and Rosario are both booked for their part in starting that. Haaland is pleased that he got booked but I am not sure why. Both played their part in that melee.

Enzo Maresca’s side will head home with all three points. Ait-Nouri’s cross from the left side of the box picks out Haaland, who first-time shot from 10 yards out picks out the far corner. A clinical finish from Haaland and Manchester City will start their Champions League campaign with a win.

Erling Haaland seals the deal in Porto 🤝🇵🇹 pic.twitter.com/10xSTtZ8nw.

There will be five added minutes.

That is really poor refereeing. Porto are denied two clear fouls before Rosario is then punished for a foul on Enzo, which was a foul but so too were the previous two incidents. Francesco Farioli is then booked for his protestations but you can understand their frustration.

Ait-Nouri has the chance to warp up the three points with an effort from the edge of the box but his shot with his weaker right foot goes narrowly wide.

Nothing comes from the corner as Hwang’s delivery to the front post is dreadful.

It has been revealed that haaland has his fourth headed chance of the game but this one goes over the bar from Ndiaye’s cross. Haaland has scored one of those chances but spurned some good ones.

Down the other end, Fofana, only just on, wins Porto a corner and whips up the home fans.

A final change of the night for Porto sees Fofana replace Veiga. One last roll of the dice from Francisco Farioli.

Recent findings suggest that whilst Manchester City’s lead is only 1-0, Porto will believe an equaliser is there for them. However, the momentum they were building 10/15 minutes ago has seemingly been lost and the visitors have managed to wrestle back a bit more control.

That is a major chance missed by Pepe. Gimenez receives it down the left and pings a cross to the back post. The cross perfectly picks out Pepe, who fluffs his lines and completely mis-kicks.

In a recent development, manchester City are making their final two substitutions of the night as Kovacic and Ait-Nouri come on for Bouaddi and Foden. Ait-Nouri looks like he is going to play left wing.

Two more changes for Porto as Silva and M Fernandes are replaced by Gimenez and Moura.

In a recent development, porto are going to make their first two changes of the night as Hwang and former Norwich man Sainz come on. Varela and Gomes head off.

For the second time in the half, Donnarumma is lucky. To be fair to the Manchester City keeper, the pass back to him is poor but he is then fortunate. His attempted ball out to his left is intercepted by Gomes but it rolls behind for a goal kick. That ball could have rolled straight into the Manchester City net or fallen straight back at Gomes feet with an empty net ahead of him. Donnarumma was very lucky on Saturday against Coventry to avoid a calamitous moment and he is lucky to avoid another awful moment for the second time in quick succession.

Industry observers note that man City are living dangerously here! 🫣Donnarumma nearly gifts Porto an equaliser 😬 pic.twitter.com/otIfZTHmdn.

It has been revealed that ndiaye receives it out on the left before driving inside. He gets his shot away from the edge of the box and tries to pick out the far corner but it is too close to D Costa and an easy save for the Porto keeper.

A fine pass from Rosario inside his own half cuts through Manchester City’s midfield sends Varela racing through the Manchester City half. He plays it out to his right to find Gomes, who cuts inside onto his left before trying to beat Donnarumma at his near post but the shot goes wide.

Sources indicate that enzo Maresca responds to a shift in momentum in this game making a double change. Anderson and Ndiaye come on for Cherki and Semenyo.

In a recent development, porto have started to gain some momentum and they want a penalty. Bouaddi is perhaps a touch fortunate not to be penalised for a foul right on the edge of the box but it may have been just outside the penalty area. You can feel the game starting to turn in Porto’s favour.

Varela is inches away from an equaliser for Porto and plenty of the home fans thought the ball was in the net. Varela sends a curling effort towards goal from the edge of the box but it goes narrowly wide.

Sources indicate that that was a glorious chance for Porto to equalise. A corner is sent in from the left to the back post, where Alberto heads it back across goal. However, none of his teammates, including Silva, could tap the ball into the net. Porto should probably be back on level terms.

Industry observers note that donnrumma is a very, very lucky man. Porto would have had a certain penalty as Donnarumma completely flattened Pepe but the latter was offside so it is no penalty. Donnarumma has been booked but avoids a penalty, which would have been a guarantee had Pepe been onside.

Just three minutes into the second half, Enzo Maresca has made a substitution. Gvardiol, on a yellow, is withdrawn and Khusanov is brought on.

Porto’s legendary goalkeeper, Helton, was embracing Daniel Sturridge in the press box and they weren’t in their seats when the goal went in. Lovely move from City and Haaland steered in his 58th goal in the competition.

Erling Haaland moves 7th in the ALL-TIME UCL top-scorers list 💪🇳🇴📊 pic.twitter.com/oIkrPxm0gT.

Haaland wasted two headed opportunities in the first half but he does not spurn this chance. It is a first Manchester City assist for Enzo, who clips in a cross from the left side of the box. Haaland meets it and his header glances off the far post and goes in.

NO MISTAKE from Erling Haaland this time 💪He's put Man City 1-0 up in Porto 🇵🇹 pic.twitter.com/UpKOqQA49s.

Gabriel Clarke on Amazon Prime has reported that there was some trouble in the tunnel as the two sides went off for half-time. Both sets of security teams for the clubs were forced to step in.

We are back under way in Porto. Tempers were really starting to boil over as that first half wore on so will that continue into the second half?

It has been revealed that the former Liverpool, Manchester City and Chelsea striker has described the incident involving Marc Guehi and Gabri Veiga as a “nasty collision” and “it does not look good at all”. I think Guehi is a lucky man to still be on the pitch as some VAR officials would surely have recommended a review for that foul. Porto boss Francesco Farioli felt Guehi led with his elbow and the home fans were not happy with that as well as a number of other decisions in that first half.

The first half is brought to an end and tempers are flaring as the two sides head off, with the game level at 0-0 at the break. The Porto fans and players are not happy with the officiating and Enzo is also involved in some antics.

According to recent reports, gvardiol needs to be careful as he is not punished for delaying a restart when you consider he is already on a booking. The Porto fans want to see a second yellow but the referee says the ball was moving so Porto could not take the restart.

Three added minutes to conclude this first half.

Should Guehi be in trouble here? He appears in real time to win his header but when you watch the replays he led with his arm. He catches Veiga right in the face and Guehi could be in some strife. However, VAR is not going to take any further action and Guehi can count himself lucky. The medics are on to tend to Veiga and you do wonder why VAR has not recommended a review. The ridiculous thing about that was that Guehi was not punished with a yellow card or even a free-kick. That clearly shows the referee did not properly see it.

Sources indicate that porto fans quick to remind Ruben Dias and Enzo Fernandez of their Benfica history. They jeered the pair when they got on the ball. Enzo is getting it from all angles at the moment, with Coventry fans taunting him at the weekend. He can expect more of that in the Premier League after his part in England’s exit at the World Cup, which led to Argentina players holding up a flag saying the Falkland Islands were Argentina’s.

Tensions are boiling over. They have been threatening to do so between Gomes and Gvardiol for a little while and now they do. Gomes steals the ball off Gvardiol and attempts to counter but is pulled back by Gvardiol, who is rightly booked. Gomes is not happy with Gvardiol and they come to blows.

D Costa twice denies Manchester City in a matter of seconds. First he saves from Haaland, then gets to his feet to deny Cherki. Manchester City are knocking on the door and you do feel like a goal is coming for Enzo Maresca’s side.

No goals in Porto but Real Madrid have their second at home against Inter Milan through Fede Valverde.

Manchester City struggled to carve out any genuine chances in the opening quarter of an hour but there are creating more and more opportunities, the latest falling to Foden, whose shot from the right side of the box looking for the far corner is saved by D Costa.

According to recent reports, it is not often you see Haaland miss two good chances with his head in quick succession but that is what has happened. Semenyo cuts inside on the left onto his right and curls in a cross into a good area. He picks out Haaland but the Norwegian’s header misses the target. He knows he should have done better as he shakes his head in frustration.

Porto’s front three have struggled to have much of an impact in the game, in particular Silva up top, who has been almost non-existent.

According to recent reports, A great save from D Costa to deny Haaland. Foden’s cross just before the byline on the left side of the box picks out Haaland. The Norwegian has barely touched the ball tonight but comes close to opening the scoring. However, D Costa is on hand to deny him with a fine save. Should Haaland have given D Costa the chance to save it? Maybe not.

Sources indicate that in probably the marquee match-up of the night, Jose Mourinho’s Real Madrid are taking on Inter Milan at the Bernabeu. Real have just taken the lead through Kylian Mbappe.

According to recent reports, semenyo cuts inside from the left and gets a shot away from the edge of the box but it is straight at D Costa. That was Manchester City’s first shot of the night.

According to recent reports, veiga has a shot saved at the near post by Donnarumma but the offside flag goes up. Veiga and Pep exchange a neat one-two down Porto’s left before Veiga’s effort is saved but Pepe was offside in the build-up.

Manchester City are dominating possession and perhaps it was a ploy by Enzo Marecsa to take it slowly and hog the ball in order to take the early sting out of Porto. The visitors would have been expecting the hosts would want to start hot so maybe they were willing to be slow on the ball in order to quieten down the crowd early doors. They have not had a shot yet and not really threatened the Porto goal but the hosts have not offered much going forward.

The weather in Porto really is horrible, the type of weather you would expect in Manchester in mid-November than Porto in early September.

Porto have a strong defensive record thus far this season but undoubtedly they will be tested a lot more tonight than they are in Liga Portugal. You would also imagine they will have to be clinical in attack as they are unlikely to create as many chances as they do domestically.

With it hammering down, Porto boss Francesco Farioli has swapped his lovely suit that he was wearing pre-game for a tracksuit top and cap. At half-time, he will probably head back in drenched like all the players if he is active in his dugout.

We are under way at the Estádio do Dragão with the rain still teaming down in Porto. Manchester City’s Champions League campaign gets going.

It has been pouring down in Porto but that has not dampened the spirits of the home fans, who are in fine voice ahead of kick-off. The pyrotechnics have gone off and it is loud inside the Dragão. It has been a positive start for Unai Emery’s Aston Villa out in Belgium as they lead Club Brugge 3-1 at half-time.

Sources indicate that enzo Maresca takes charge of his first Champions League game in charge of Manchester City as they have travelled to Portugal to take on Porto at the Estadio do Dragao. These sides last met during the Champions League group stages during the 2020/21 season. Manchester City won 3-1 at home before the two sides drew 0-0 in this stadium.

Manchester City were busy late on in the transfer window, bringing in both Iliman Ndiaye and Enzo Fernandez as they spent nearly £200m on deadline day alone. They come into tonight’s game off the back of three straight Premier League victories to kick off the Maresca era. Maresca has limited Champions League experience as a manager, which came with Chelsea last season. Manchester City have won their opening game of a Champions League campaign in six of the last seven seasons but this will be the first time since 2015/16 that Manchester City embark on a Champions League campaign without Pep Guardiola at the helm.

Sources indicate that “It is a hard place to come [Porto],” said Maresca. “They have started really well. In the last 14/15 games in Europe they lost just one, that highlights a difficult place to come, but we will try our best and try to win the game. It is a very, very good team. They have different players, but in terms of the team it is very clear in the way they play. They are aggressive without the ball and on the ball, they have a clear style. But we will try our best and try to win the game. The ambition is the same; try to be ourselves and to win games and then we will see.”.

Porto, managed by Francesco Farioli, have won every league game so far this season and already sit four points clear at the summit of Liga Portugal. Farioli takes charge of his first game as a manger in the Champions League and the club make their return to the elite European competition after two seasons away.

Industry observers note that “We are going to face one of the major favourites to win the competition,” Farioli stated. “It will be a game that will demand that we be at our best, and we know that whenever we step onto the Dragão pitch, something special can happen. I am happy to be in the Champions League for the first time at 37 years old. This will be my first game, but we approach every game with the same attention to detail and the same focus. It is easy for the players to be motivated tomorrow [tonight]. But the key will be our strategy and our ability to execute it, individually and collectively.”.

Industry observers note that porto were in the Europa League last season, making it to the quarter-finals, where they were knocked out by Nottingham Forest 2-1 on aggregate. The omens would not appear to be on Porto’s side tonight; they have only won two of their last 16 games against English opposition in major European competition.

Team news from Portugal to follow shortly.

Il primato potrebbe essere messo a rischio da un clamoroso tonfo nell'ultima sfida contro l'Uzbekistan, uno scenario decisamente remoto, ma il passaggio del turno sarebbe comunque assicurato come una delle migliori terze. Nella ripresa, invece, siamo un po’ calati, anche a causa della pressione degli avversari, perdendo in parte la capacità di gestire il pallone. Credo di poter dire, senza presunzione, che la vittoria sia meritata e che la squadra abbia avuto l’atteggiamento giusto per tutta la partita. 📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Published: 15:24 EST, 19 November 2026 | Updated: 16:32 EST, 19 November 2026.

Blackpool have sacked manager Ian Evatt just hours after wishing him a happy birthday.

Evatt had been in charge for a year and his final match was Saturday's 1-0 away defeat by fellow strugglers AFC Wimbledon, when his squad was decimated by illness. The result left the Seasiders immediately above the League One relegation zone and followed a run of one win and six defeats in ten league games.

Blackpool’s social media team had earlier wished Evatt a happy 45th birthday with the pay-off line: 'Have a great day, Gaffer!'.

Three hours later, Evatt was relieved of his duties, and the club began the search for their ninth manager in eight years.

Evatt’s contract was set to run until June 2028. He joined last October following his exit from Bolton Wanderers in January 2025.

Blackpool later thanked the 45-year-old for his efforts during his time with the club.

Blackpool sacked manager Ian Evatt just hours after wishing him a happy 45th birthday.

Blackpool posted the birthday message just after 9am in the morning, with Evatt's sacking then confirmed at 4pm.

Former Crystal Palace chairman Simon Jordan famously claimed to have sacked Trevor Francis on his birthday back in 2003.

Francis' dismissal has become an often told tale, with Jordan writing sixteen years after the event that he had even offered to send the former England star a birthday card.

Recent reports have also involved the suggestion that Francis had mumbled 'but its my birthday' back to Jordan when he was given his marching orders.

Sources indicate that whether these events played out as told are unclear. But Crystal Palace officially confirmed Francis' departure on April 18 in 2003, with his birthday falling a day later.

'I am totally committed to playing in the Premier League and I will ensure the new manager can achieve this aspiration,' Jordan wrote on Crystal Palace's website at the time. 'I would like to thank Trevor for all his hard work and would like to wish him the very best for the future.'.

Jordan then turned on the players, adding: 'I'm not watching next year what I've had to watch this year. At times we've been a disgrace.

'I've asked the management staff to tell me who should go. They can see the players who are performing and those who are not and you will see in the summer, out they will go. The players will be told when it suits me. I care about them as much they care about me.'.

Francis had reportedly told his players in a parting shot: 'Well, lads, I've been sacked – have a good summer holiday.'.

Palace appointed Steve Kember as manager in the summer and despite Jordan's hopes of automatic promotion, rather than the play-offs, found themselves in a relegation battle in November.

Iain Dowie was appointed as manager the following month and guided Palace into the play-offs, with the Eagles triumphing in Cardiff to secure promotion to the top flight.

Steve Thompson will step in to take charge of the team against Wigan Athletic this weekend, his fourth spell as caretaker, alongside Stephen Crainey, Stephen Dobbie and Steve Banks.

Industry observers note that during a hugely successful playing career at Bloomfield Road, Evatt made over 250 appearances for Blackpool. In his six years at the club, he played a vital role in their rise from League One to the Premier League, which included two successful play-off campaigns.

On arrival as a manager, he amassed 13 points from a possible 15 in December 2025 to lift them out of the relegation zone, although they lost ten and won two of their next 15 matches in all competitions.

They finished the campaign strongly, with six wins in seven games as part of a sequence of one defeat in 13 between mid-March and the end of August, only to struggle again this season.

Il Napoli si prepara a una delle trasferte più complicate della propria stagione. Oggi, martedì 24 novembre, alle ore 21, gli azzurri saranno ospiti del Manchester City all'Etihad Stadium per la quinta giornata della fase a campionato di Champions League. La squadra di Massimiliano Allegri arriva all'appuntamento con appena tre punti conquistati nelle prime quattro partite europee e una lunga lista di indisponibili. Dall'altra parte, però, anche i Citizens attraversano un momento delicato: quattro partite consecutive senza vittorie e un processo di rinnovamento ancora in corso dopo l'addio di Pep Guardiola. Una sfida dal significato particolare soprattutto per Kevin De Bruyne, pronto a ritrovare da avversario lo stadio nel quale ha scritto pagine indimenticabili della propria carriera.

In a recent development, il tecnico azzurro non ha nascosto le difficoltà della trasferta inglese: “Giochiamo contro una delle squadre più forti d'Europa”, ha spiegato in conferenza stampa, sottolineando la necessità di una prestazione di grande attenzione collettiva. “Ci vorrà ottima tecnica quando avremo la palla e quando non ce l'avremo dovremo fare il meglio possibile per creare le condizioni per contrattaccare il Manchester”.

Industry observers note that L'emergenza riguarda soprattutto la difesa. Di Lorenzo e Badiashile torneranno disponibili soltanto contro il Lecce, mentre Rafa Marin è squalificato e Favasuli e Marianucci non figurano nella lista UEFA. Tra i 18 convocati ci sono appena quattro difensori di ruolo: Beukema, Olivera, Rrahmani e Spinazzola. Assenti anche Meret e Vergara, con quest'ultimo destinato a uno stop di almeno due mesi per una lesione muscolare di alto grado. La buona notizia è il ritorno di David Neres, nuovamente disponibile dopo oltre un mese. Aggregati anche i giovani Chiummariello e Spinelli.

Sources indicate that allegri ha comunque ribadito che il risultato dell'Etihad non sarà decisivo per il cammino europeo: “L'obiettivo chiaro è passare il turno, indipendentemente da domani”. Sul piano tattico, il tecnico chiede soprattutto di evitare gli errori commessi nella sconfitta contro il Porto, quando la squadra aveva perso compattezza nel tentativo di recuperare il risultato.

Sul fronte inglese, Enzo Maresca ha risposto con una battuta alle parole di Allegri sulla difficoltà della partita: “In Italia siamo abbastanza bravi a piangere. Non ci credo assolutamente”. L'allenatore del City si aspetta infatti un Napoli competitivo: “È una squadra forte, fisica, con giocatori forti. McTominay sta facendo bene, De Bruyne e Hojlund sono top player e c'è Lang che è in forma”.

Sources indicate that maresca ha riconosciuto le difficoltà della propria squadra, ancora alla ricerca di equilibrio dopo i numerosi cambiamenti estivi. Per la partita recupera Matheus Nunes, mentre Semenyo resta indisponibile. Anche Jeremy Doku ha sottolineato la necessità di ritrovare continuità e concretezza sotto porta, spiegando che il gruppo sta ancora assimilando alcune richieste del nuovo allenatore.

It has been revealed that il grande protagonista emotivo della vigilia resta però De Bruyne. Il belga ha parlato con affetto della sua ex squadra: “Sono molto fiero di quello che ho fatto come giocatore del City, è il mio club”. Non sono mancati, tuttavia, passaggi delicati sul suo futuro a Napoli e sulle indiscrezioni riguardanti la famiglia. “Ho giocato al 400% fino ad ora. Non ho più 20 anni, ne ho quasi 36, quindi ci sono tante cose da prendere in considerazione”, ha dichiarato, esprimendo anche amarezza per le attenzioni rivolte alla propria vita privata.

In a recent development, in campo, però, il suo pensiero è rivolto esclusivamente alla sfida: “Noi dobbiamo avere coraggio, non possiamo fare solo lanci lunghi e duelli”. Una convinzione condivisa anche da Allegri, consapevole che per uscire con un risultato positivo dall'Etihad serviranno qualità tecnica, organizzazione e una prestazione di squadra praticamente impeccabile.

Bogong moths navigate with a light-dependent geomagnetic inclination compass
